Subject: Virtual onsite - Ozone Tech (Sr. Infra Eng) — scheduling and panel request

Hi Vivek / Laura,

Thanks for the quick review of Alex Reed — attached is his resume and our proposed slot grid (proposed-panel-grid.xlsx). Wed like to run a single virtual day with 3 interviewer blocks and a short debrief window so we can get feedback before EOD.

Constraints: Alex is PST based, available 11:00 - 16:30 PST on 11/5 and 11/6. Prefer a compact flow (no more than four blocks).

Requests:
- Can you confirm panel sequencing (coding vs design first) and which internal assessors we should list?
- Can Redwood send calendar invites once times are final?

I've ccd Alexs recruiter (same thread) in case we need to shift times.

Attachments: alex-reed-resume.pdf, proposed-panel-grid.xlsx

Thanks,
Sara Park
Technical Recruiter — Ozone Tech
sara@ozonetech.com

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 31 Oct 2029 10:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Virtual onsite - Ozone Tech (Sr. Infra Eng) — scheduling and panel request

Sara / team,

Thanks. My suggested sequencing for a compact, decision-ready loop (fits Alexs availability):
- 20m coding exercise (Marissa) — focused on debugging/algorithms with real-time pairing
- 30m system design (Karthik) — system trade-offs and distributed systems thinking
- 25m deep-dive (behavior + infra ops) (Laura) — incident triage / on-call scenarios
- 15m async buffer + 20m live debrief (internal) — immediate capture of notes

Key asks: please confirm timezone is PST for invites and whether Alex needs any accommodations for the pairing exercise. Also confirm whether the recruiter prefers the 11/5 or 11/6 slot; given the window I'd prefer 11/5 12:00-15:00 PST to keep feedback same-day.

If youd want a different order (e.g., design first), we can swap but keep coding and design separated by the deep-dive to reduce context switching. Attaching a small panel-order-v2.xlsx (quick tweak).

I can draft the calendar invites once we lock times; would appreciate Lauras final interviewer list + any alternate backfills.

Vivek Kulkarni
Hiring Manager, Infra
Redwood Inference

- 30m system design (Karthik)
- 20m coding exercise (Marissa)
- 25m infra deep-dive + behavioral (me)
- 20m internal debrief (Vivek/Laura/Marissa/Karthik)

I updated the grid (panel-order-v2.xlsx) to reflect start times for 11/5, PST. Ive penciled in the following interviewers: Karthik (design), Marissa (coding), Laura (infra/behavior). If any of you need a backfill, note as alternate on the grid.

Two quick operational notes:
- Please keep each block tightly timeboxed; use the first 5 minutes for context and last 3 minutes for a one-line takeaway to speed debriefs.
- For the pairing/coding block: Marissa, if you want Alex to share a Google Doc in advance or use a specific IDE, call it out in the invite.

Sara: can you confirm the candidates preferred day (11/5 vs 11/6) and whether they can do the 12:00 start? If 12:00 PST works, I will finalize the calendar invites and duration blocks.

Laura Bennett
